title: World Bloom — Dear My Fellows — Episode9 How It Felt Back Then

meta.Episode: Episode9 — How It Felt Back Then
meta.Event Outline: Having trained with three famous troupes, Wonderlands×Showtime has certainly grown. While checking for any changes in their SEKAI, they hear of a problem with the tree, and are shown a world where they are each chasing their own dreams.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're thinking about leaving the Wonder Stage...?

rows.Speaker: Shiratori
rows.Line: Yes. I'm sorry, I know this is probably coming as a huge shock...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, don't mind me!
Umm... But can you begin by telling me why?

rows.Speaker: Shiratori
rows.Line: Because... I have a dream that I want to fulfill.

rows.Speaker: Shiratori
rows.Line: I decided to join this troupe because I admired Wonderlands×Showtime so much... But while performing here, I began to think...

rows.Speaker: Shiratori
rows.Line: I want to make more people smile...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Make more people smile...?

rows.Speaker: Shiratori
rows.Line: Yes... I thought about this for a really long time. I love the Wonder Stage very much. But...

rows.Speaker: Shiratori
rows.Line: I also want to make my dream come true. So...

rows.Speaker: Shiratori
rows.Line: That's why...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll go and do my best.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shiratori
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The guests who come to the Wonder Stage really love your acting, so I'm sure you'll be able to make lots and lots of people smile...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Break a leg. I'll be rooting for you...!

rows.Speaker: Shiratori
rows.Line: Ms. Otori...

rows.Speaker: Shiratori
rows.Line: Thank you! I'll do my best...!
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (No, this is the right answer...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (This is...)
How are you? You can tell us if something's bothering you, okay?
Um, Emu... You don't have to make yourself smile if something is making you feel sad!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Who said those things just now...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wait, what...?! It's already this late?!
The meeting's gonna start soon!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I have to go get those papers about the lights, find the right meeting room and... No, there's so much I need to do!
se_run_women_001_1
Evening
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: These attendance figures aren't bad.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, since we held quite a few events last month. We're experiencing a nice influx at the moment, but we'll see how the rest of this month pans out without anything special going on...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We'll want to look at the numbers and trends for each area while we're at it.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Right. I'll make sure to get a hold of them.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: If there's nothing else to report, then I think we can call it a day...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
I have nothing else to add.
What about you, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There is something I wanna discuss with you guys.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I see. Shiratori wants to leave...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
He's gonna leave the Wonder Stage in order to go make his dream come true. So...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're probably gonna have to start holding auditions to find a new troupe member to fill his spot.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He won't actually be leaving for a little while, but I think we should come up with a schedule now before—

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Stop right there.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Does this mean you already agreed to let him go...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Yeah, I did...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You're joking, right...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Now I see...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: What you did may've been in Shiratori's best interest...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But you definitely made a serious administrative mistake.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Setting aside whether or not he would've accepted any counteroffers, he's a valued asset. So, your first move should've been to stop him.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Given that you had a chance to do so...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I mean, at this point, Shiratori's the face of the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I don't even want to begin thinking about how the guests are going to react when they hear the news.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, you guys are right...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As your brother, I'd like to ask...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Did it ever cross your mind to get him to stay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Did it ever cross my mind...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It was sad to hear, but I wanted to show him my support...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, Shiratori's such a dazzling actor. You can't help but smile when you see him perform...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I want him to make his dream come true and put smiles on the faces of even more people...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Is that all...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I understand wanting to respect his dreams and wishes. But...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Lately, I feel that you've been doing everything in your power to suppress your own feelings...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: In particular, when it comes to people leaving.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
And this all started...
Around the time the other members of Wonderlands×Showtime left, I want to say.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanted us to keep going...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanted to keep seeing people smile from the Wonder Stage together...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But... But...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If I stopped them, and that prevented their dreams from coming true...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: It's okay for you to be a little more honest about how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: So, if you're feeling sad, then you should say that you're sad.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: To us... And your friends.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, there's bound to come a day when the nature of your position demands that you not waver. But, for now...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You should stop turning a blind eye and suppressing your feelings if it means forcing yourself...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A-Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want to help people make their dreams come true... I don't want to get in their way...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I can't say there's anything wrong with that, but... It's perfectly normal for you to feel sad.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: After all, they're your friends, and you put on shows with them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Right. It's perfectly normal to feel this way...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (To feel sad and want to do shows with them again...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I thought I had to not say what I was feeling so I wouldn't get in their way...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But these feelings that are still lingering inside me...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It's okay for me to hold on to them.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Including the tightness I felt in my chest that time...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's call it a day here.
I'm sure you still have some things you need to do.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Aren't you throwing that farewell party with Wonderlands×Showtime?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
N-N-N-No, I forgot!
I still have a ton left to do for that!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What's there to do? They're just coming to visit the park, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I have to make special farewell party guidebooks for us! And I still haven't decided how I want them to look...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm gonna head back to my room!
Good night, Keisuke, Shosuke!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Okay, good night.
se_run_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What did she mean, “farewell party guidebooks”...?
Weekend
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, I'm the first one here♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Hehe. I'm glad I was able to finish making those guidebooks.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm calling this plan “Operation: Let's Go See Shows At All The Stages☆”)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It's got all the shows I recommend seeing when you're at Phoenix Wonderland, and tons of trivia!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I really hope they like them.)
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Oh, Ms. Otori, there you are...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Doesn't he work at the Wonder Stage?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Umm... Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, I know this is your day off...
But we've run into a bit of trouble.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: The thing is, the cast is trying to fly back from their traveling performance, but they're currently stuck at the airport due to inclement weather.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: If nothing improves, they're not going to make it back in time for today's afternoon showing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?
